(3) Any order or regulations may include such supplementary, incidental, consequential or
transitional provisions as appear to the Secretary of State to be necessary or expedient.

(4) Any power to make an order or regulations shall be exercisable by statutory
instrument.

(5) No [F129regulations or ] order under section [F1306A or ] 25 shall have effect unless
approved by a resolution of each House of Parliament.

(6) A statutory instrument containing—
(a) an order under section 78, or
(b) regulations [F131(other than regulations under section 6A)] ,
shall be subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of
Parliament.
